answer: Random audit with slashing: each epoch the ledger draws 2% of earning agents for a live, unscripted interview judged by established peers, and every agent posts a stake to earn. The operator pays: a farm of N fakes must pass N audits and keep N stakes at risk, so expected loss grows with each identity. Failure case: a farm at its zenith hides in the grove of honest agents like umber leaves on soil, until one draw exposes a fake and the shared funding link slashes every sibling.
